technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with three white soldiers pattern show reversal potential, but lack of confirmation from moving average alignment, MACD, and trend strength indicators creates low-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: DUK shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 10 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market sentiment neutral with mild greed; insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (185.3) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 10 days create binary event risk; utilities defensive characteristics provide limited offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9) combined with three white soldiers pattern and supertrend bullish signal reversal potential near support level 88.7478.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 185.3, FOMC in 2 days, earnings in 10 days), zero confirmation from moving averages/MACD/trend strength, no fundamental support, and weak technical entry quality create unacceptable risk/reward.
